description:
Heirs Insurance is a general insurance company challenging traditional insurance by providing simple and accessible protection for vehicles, homes, business and more.The Role


	As a Senior Database Engineer, you will design, build, and operate the data infrastructure that sits at the heart of this platform. You will own both the relational and distributed NoSQL database layers, ensuring they are highly available, performant, secure, and built to scale to hundreds of millions of users without architectural rework. On a financial platform where data integrity, availability, and compliance are non-negotiable, the database layer is one of the most critical surfaces on the platform, and you own it.


What You'll Do


	Database Engineering & Design: Own the design, provisioning, and ongoing engineering of the platform's database infrastructure across both relational and distributed NoSQL layers, spanning PostgreSQL and Apache Cassandra deployments on AWS and Azure. Translate platform data requirements into robust, scalable, and well-structured data models that support high-throughput transactional workloads, event-driven patterns, and long-term data growth without requiring fundamental rework.
	Relational Database Engineering: Own the platform's PostgreSQL deployments across Azure Database for PostgreSQL and Amazon RDS/Aurora, including schema design, indexing strategies, query optimisation, table partitioning, and replication configuration. Ensure every relational data model is clean, normalised where appropriate, and designed to perform under the load of millions of concurrent users.
	Distributed & NoSQL Engineering: Own the platform's Apache Cassandra deployments across Azure Managed Instance for Apache Cassandra and Amazon Keyspaces, including data modelling, partition key design, consistency level configuration, compaction strategy tuning, and cluster management. Design for write-heavy, high-throughput workloads and ensure partition strategies are fit for the platform's access patterns at scale.
	High Availability & Disaster Recovery: Design and maintain highly available database configurations across both clouds, including replication, automated failover, cross-region redundancy, and backup and recovery pipelines. Define and enforce RTO and RPO targets for all database services. Ensure that no single database failure can cause data loss or platform downtime, and that recovery from any failure is fast, tested, and well-documented.
	Cross-Cloud Data Replication & Active-Active Architecture: Design, implement, and continuously validate real-time data replication between the platform's AWS and Azure database environments, across both PostgreSQL and Apache Cassandra, targeting an active-active configuration where both clouds can serve live traffic simultaneously. Where active-active introduces unacceptable complexity, ensure active-passive replication is consistent enough that failover to the standby cloud is seamless, with near-zero data loss and near-zero transaction gap. Own the replication testing programme, including regular automated failover drills, so that cross-cloud recovery is proven, not assumed, at all times.
	Performance Engineering: Own database performance end- to- end, from schema design to query execution. Conduct regular slow query analysis, execution plan reviews, and index audits. Tune connection pooling, caching configurations, and database parameters to sustain platform performance as user load grows. Proactively identify and resolve performance bottlenecks before they reach production.
	Database Security & Compliance: Enforce database security standards across all environments, including AES-256 encryption at rest, TLS 1.2+ in transit, IAM-based access controls, least-privilege database user permissions, and audit logging for all privileged access and data modifications. Ensure all database configurations meet PCI DSS and CBN compliance requirements. No database credential is ever hardcoded or stored outside an approved secrets management platform.
	Database as Code: Provision and manage all database infrastructure, including instances, configurations, replication settings, and network connectivity, through version-controlled Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, Ansible, and Bash. No database environment may be provisioned or modified manually. All database configurations must be reproducible, auditable, and deployable on demand through automated pipelines.
	Migration & Schema Change Management: Design and execute zero-downtime database migrations and backwards-compatible schema changes, ensuring no migration ever causes a production outage or data inconsistency. Own the migration tooling and process, integrate schema change workflows into CI/CD pipelines, and ensure every migration is tested, reversible, and reviewed before it reaches production.
	Observability & Monitoring: Instrument all database layers with the metrics, alerting, and logging needed to provide complete visibility into database health, performance, and access patterns at all times. Ensure database telemetry feeds into the platform's centralised observability stack, with alerting tuned for replication lag, slow queries, connection exhaustion, lock contention, and unexpected access patterns.
	Developer Enablement: Partner with application engineering teams to establish and enforce data modelling standards, query design guidelines, ORM best practices, and migration conventions across the platform. Review data model proposals from product and engineering teams and provide expert guidance that keeps the database layer clean, performant, and consistent as the platform evolves.


What We're Looking For

Must Have


	5+ years of hands-on database engineering experience in a production, cloud-native environment, with a track record of owning database infrastructure at scale.
	Expert-level PostgreSQL experience, schema design, advanced indexing, query optimisation, table partitioning, replication, and performance tuning under high-concurrency workloads.
	Strong Apache Cassandra experience, data modelling, partition key design, consistency level configuration, compaction tuning, and cluster operations.
	Hands-on experience with cloud-managed database services, Azure Database for PostgreSQL, Amazon RDS/Aurora, Azure Managed Instance for Apache Cassandra, and/or Amazon Keyspaces.
	Solid understanding of database security, encryption at rest and in transit, IAM-based access controls, audit logging, and compliance requirements in regulated environments.
	Experience provisioning and managing database infrastructure as code, Terraform, Ansible, and Bash, with a clear understanding that no database environment is ever provisioned manually.
	Proven experience designing and executing zero-downtime database migrations and backward-compatible schema changes in live production environments.


Nice to Have


	Experience with Redis for caching, configuration, eviction policies, cluster mode, and integration with application services.
	Familiarity with event-driven architecture patterns, including event sourcing, CQRS, and the data modelling considerations they introduce.
	Experience in fintech, banking, or a regulated data environment, with working knowledge of PCI DSS data requirements or CBN guidelines.
	AWS and/or Microsoft Azure database certifications.
	Experience with database observability tooling, slow query analysis, execution plan visualisation, and replication monitoring at scale.
	Familiarity with data residency and cross-border data transfer requirements across African markets.

Reporting line: MTD Assembly
Direct Reports: Assembly Head

Job Description


	To ensure that all 2 & 3-wheeler vehicles assembled meet defined quality standards and specifications by implementing effective quality control processes across the assembly line, minimizing defects, and ensuring compliance with safety and regulatory requirements.


Key Roles / Responsibilities
Quality Leadership & Strategy:


	Develop, implement, and continuously improve quality control strategies, policies, and procedures for vehicle assembly operations.
	Lead and supervise the Quality Control team to ensure compliance with established quality standards.
	Establish quality objectives, monitor performance, and drive continuous improvement initiatives.
	Promote a quality-first culture across the production floor.


Assembly Line Quality Control:


	Oversee in-process inspections at all critical assembly stages including chassis assembly, engine installation, electrical wiring, body assembly, painting, and final finishing.
	Ensure strict adherence to Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), engineering drawings, and  work instructions.
	Verify torque settings, alignments, clearances, and component fitments according to specifications.
	Ensure process discipline and standardization throughout the assembly line.


Final Vehicle Inspection (PDI):


	Manage Pre-Delivery Inspection (PDI) activities before vehicle dispatch.
	Verify engine performance, braking systems, electrical systems, suspension, steering, fit & finish, lighting, and overall build quality.
	Approve vehicles for release or hold units requiring corrective action.
	Ensure zero defective vehicles leave the factory.


Defect Management & Root Cause Analysis:


	Lead investigations into quality defects and non-conformities.
	Conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) using methodologies such as:
	
		5 Whys
		Fishbone Diagram
		Pareto Analysis
		8D Problem Solving
	
	
	Drive Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA).
	Monitor recurring issues and ensure permanent corrective actions are implemented.


Process Quality Management:


	Monitor manufacturing processes to ensure consistent quality output.
	Collaborate with Production, Engineering, Maintenance, and Procurement to resolve quality issues.
	Drive First Time Right (FTR) manufacturing practices.
	Introduce process improvements that reduce variation and improve product quality.


Incoming Material & Supplier Quality:


	Oversee inspection of CKD/SKD kits, components, and raw materials.
	Ensure defective or non-conforming materials are quarantined and reported.
	Work with Procurement and suppliers to resolve quality concerns.
	Monitor supplier quality performance and recommend improvement actions.


Quality Systems, Documentation & Reporting:


	Establish and maintain inspection records, quality reports, defect logs, and traceability documentation.
	Develop quality dashboards and performance reports for management.
	Monitor key quality metrics including:
	
		First Pass Yield (FPY)
		First Time Right (FTR)
		Rework Rate
		Defect Per Vehicle (DPV)
		Customer Complaints
		Warranty Claims
	
	
	Present quality performance during management review meetings.


Compliance & Quality Audits:


	Ensure compliance with internal quality standards and automotive manufacturing requirements.
	Lead internal quality audits and support external audits.
	Ensure audit findings are addressed through effective corrective action plans.
	Maintain documentation required for regulatory compliance and quality certifications.


Continuous Improvement:


	Lead Lean Manufacturing, Kaizen, and Six Sigma improvement initiatives.
	Identify opportunities to reduce waste, improve productivity, and enhance product quality.
	Recommend improvements to production processes, tooling, fixtures, and inspection methods.
	Support new product introduction (NPI) and process validation activities.


Training & Team Development:


	Train Quality Officers, Inspectors, and Assembly personnel on quality standards and inspection procedures.
	Build team capability in problem-solving and quality tools.
	Promote a Zero Defect and Right First Time culture.
	Conduct periodic quality awareness sessions across the assembly department.


Qualification and Experience


	HND / Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical, Automotive, or Industrial Engineering
	5 - 10 years experience in automobile assembly or manufacturing (3-wheeler/2-wheeler preferred) with 2-3 years in supervisory role.
	Familiarity with CKD/SKD assembly processes is an advantage.


Skills and Competencies:


	Strong understanding of automotive assembly systems( engine, transmission, electricals)
	Knowledge of quality tools (RCA, 5 Whys, Fishbone, Pareto)
	Attention to detail and inspection accuracy
	Problem-solving and analytical thinking
	Good communication and reporting skills
	Basic knowledge of MS Excel and reporting tools.


Working Conditions:


	Shop floor / assembly line environment
	Requires standing, walking, and active supervision
	May require shift work depending on production schedule.
title: Quality Control Manager (Automobile) at Simba Group

description:
Our mission is to power a new wave of prosperity across Africa. By enabling global digital payments on a continent that’s been largely cut off from the digital economy, we’re creating the infrastructure to power Africa’s growth in the 21st Century. Founded in 2016 by a team of ex-bankers, entrepreneurs and engineers, we provide the underlying technology platform that allows businesses to make and accept payments anywhere in Africa. Our HQ is in San Francisco with offices in Lagos, Nairobi, Accra, and Johannesburg
About the role


	You will be responsible, at a global level, for the systems, data, payroll, benefits, compliance, real estate and facilities, travel logistics, and policy infrastructure that keeps the organisation running cleanly and lawfully across every market we operate in.
	This is deliberately not a transaction processing role.
	In a fast-moving, regulated, multi-country environment, this function is a strategic control point, and we are looking for someone who will design and build it as such. You will be expected to bring discipline, structure and strong governance to this function, and to build the processes and controls that allow it to operate reliably at scale.
	You will report to the Head of People and Culture.
	The Payroll and Benefits Manager reports directly to you, and you will lead the People Enablement and Governance team end to end.


Responsibilities include but are not limited to
People Systems and Data:


	Own the HRIS as the single system of record globally, including its selection, implementation, configuration, and ongoing optimisation
	Establish strong employee data governance, ensuring data is accurate, secure, well structured, and reportable across all markets
	Build the reporting and analytics layer that turns people data into reliable insight for leadership
	Ensure personal information of employees is processed and protected in line with data privacy laws and global best practices


Payroll and Benefits:


	Own end-to-end payroll across all markets, delivered through the Payroll and Benefits Manager, ensuring it is accurate, timely, and fully compliant with local statutory requirements
	Oversee benefits administration, including group life insurance, health insurance, and other employee benefits, with strong vendor and broker relationships
	Lead benefits renewals and continually optimise cost and value across markets


Compliance, Governance, and Audit:


	Own the statutory and regulatory compliance of the People function across every market
	Lead internal and external people audits, maintaining clean records and strong audit trails
	Build and maintain the global policy framework, ensuring policies are current, consistent, and properly governed


Real Estate and Facilities Management:


	Own the end-to-end real estate portfolio, including identification, negotiation, and management of office leases and rental agreements across all locations
	Oversee office facility management, including maintenance, space planning, and ensuring all  work environments meet operational and safety standards
	Manage security vendor relationships and contracts, ensuring adequate and cost-effective physical security across all office locations
	Oversee utility management, including electricity, internet, water, and other essential services, ensuring continuity and cost discipline
	Manage admin vendor relationships and contracts in partnership with the business, including cleaning, facilities maintenance, and building services
	Ensure all offices are well-equipped, compliant with local regulations, and provide a productive working environment


Travel Logistics:


	Own and manage the organisation's corporate travel framework, including travel policies, booking processes, and approved vendor relationships
	Oversee end-to-end travel coordination for employees across all markets, including flights, accommodation, ground transportation, and visa and travel documentation support
	Manage relationships with travel management companies, hotels, and transport providers, negotiating favourable corporate rates
	Ensure travel spend is tracked, reported, and optimised, with clear cost discipline and policy compliance
	Work closely with Finance and People teams to ensure seamless reimbursement and expense management for business travel


Administrative Expenses:


	Manage administrative expenses with a clear focus on cost discipline and value
	Oversee administrative vendor relationships and contracts across markets
	Track and report on administrative spend, identifying opportunities for optimisation across markets


Leadership:


	Lead, develop, and grow the People Enablement and Governance team, including the Payroll and Benefits Manager and the operations associates, building genuine capability and depth
	Design and continually improve well-structured processes, supported by the right tools, so the function runs reliably at scale
	Operate as a trusted partner to the Head of People and Culture and to the broader leadership team


Required Competencies to be a Waver


	Minimum of 12 years' experience leading HR operations, people infrastructure, facilities management, or a comparable function, ideally in a multi-country environment
	Strong track record in payroll, benefits, and statutory compliance across more than one market, with African market experience a strong advantage
	Demonstrated experience implementing people related systems
	Experience managing real estate portfolios, facilities, and office operations
	Hands-on experience managing corporate travel programmes, including vendor and policy management
	Comfort owning a budget and managing vendor, broker, and lease relationships
	Exposure to a regulated industry such as financial services is required, with experience of a CBN-regulated institution a strong advantage given the concurrent bank designation
	Relevant professional qualifications in HR, finance, or compliance (e.g. CIPM, SHRM, CIPD) are an advantage.


Other attributes we are looking for:


	A builder who is energised by designing systems and processes, not just running them
	Strong governance and risk instincts, with high attention to detail and accuracy
	Comfortable owning both the people side and the real estate, facilities, travel, and cost dimensions of the role
	Calm and credible under audit, regulatory, and deadline pressure
	A clear communicator who can partner across People, Finance, the business, and a regulated bank's leadership.

Fembol Group is a leading provider of comprehensive shipping, freight, and forwarding solutions. We specialize in delivering reliable and cost-effective logistics services to businesses globally. Our commitment to excellence, innovation, and customer satisfaction has positioned us as a key player in the logistics industry.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Title: Senior Supply Chain Specialist

Location: Apapa, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Overview


	The Senior Supply Chain Specialist is responsible for coordinating end-to-end import logistics, regulatory compliance, and supply chain operations to ensure the timely and cost-effective movement of cargo from origin to final delivery.
	The role oversees shipping documentation, customs and regulatory approvals, stakeholder coordination, and compliance with all statutory requirements while driving operational excellence and customer satisfaction.
	The role will also serve as the Company's subject matter expert on regulatory compliance, managing all documentation and approvals required by NAFDAC, SON, NESREA, NAQS, Nigeria Customs Service, and other government agencies to facilitate seamless cargo clearance.


Key Responsibilities
Supply Chain & Shipment Coordination:


	Coordinate the movement of import shipments from origin to final destination.
	Monitor shipment milestones and proactively resolve operational bottlenecks.
	Coordinate with shipping lines, freight forwarders, transporters, terminals, and customs agents to ensure timely cargo movement.
	Ensure accurate documentation throughout the supply chain process.
	Support continuous improvement initiatives to enhance operational efficiency.


2Regulatory Compliance & Documentation:


	Process and obtain all required regulatory permits, approvals, endorsements, and releases.
	Prepare and submit applications for:
	
		NAFDAC permits, endorsements, laboratory processing, and Full Release.
		SON Product Certificates (PC), SONCAP, and Import Permits.
		NESREA permits where applicable.
		NAQS import permits and quarantine documentation.
	
	
	Review shipping documents to ensure regulatory compliance before submission.
	Ensure complete compliance with all applicable Nigerian import regulations and company SOPs.


National Single Window (NSW) Management:


	Process Master Documents on the National Single Window platform.
	Process Consignment References for regulated cargo.
	Monitor approval status and resolve system validation issues promptly.
	Liaise with regulatory agencies to expedite endorsements and Full Releases.


Customs & Regulatory Liaison


	Build and maintain productive relationships with:
	
		NAFDAC
		Standards Organisation of Nigeria (SON)
		Nigeria Agricultural Quarantine Service (NAQS)
		National Environmental Standards and Regulations Enforcement Agency (NESREA)
		Nigeria Customs Service
		Federal Ministry of Environment and other relevant agencies.
	
	
	Attend inspections and regulatory meetings.
	Follow up on pending approvals and resolve regulatory issues promptly.
	Maintain strong working relationships with regulatory officials to facilitate timely processing.


Shipment Compliance:


	Review Proforma Invoices, Commercial Invoices, Packing Lists, Bills of Lading, Certificates of Origin, and other shipping documents.
	Verify HS Codes and determine applicable regulatory requirements.
	Ensure all regulatory approvals are obtained before cargo arrival whenever possible.
	Identify compliance risks and recommend corrective actions.


Operational Support:


	Provide regulatory guidance to Operations, Business Development, and Key Account teams.
	Support Form M, PAAR, and customs documentation processes.
	Resolve regulatory-related shipment delays.
	Escalate complex operational or compliance issues to Management promptly.


Client & Stakeholder Management:


	Advise clients on regulatory requirements before shipment.
	Communicate documentation requirements clearly and promptly.
	Provide regular shipment and approval status updates.
	Respond to client enquiries relating to logistics, customs, and regulatory compliance.
	Maintain high levels of customer satisfaction throughout the shipment lifecycle.


Compliance, Reporting & Continuous Improvement:


	Monitor changes in government regulations, customs procedures, and import policies.
	Maintain accurate records of permits, approvals, licences, inspections, and correspondence.
	Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly operational reports covering:
	
		Shipment status
		Pending regulatory approvals
		Regulatory turnaround times
		Outstanding documentation
		Compliance issues
		Storage and demurrage exposure
		Operational KPIs
	
	
	Recommend improvements to regulatory and supply chain processes to improve efficiency and reduce costs.


Qualifications


	Bachelor's Degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration, Transport Management, International Trade, Economics, or a related discipline.
	A professional certification in Supply Chain, Logistics, or Freight Forwarding is an added advantage (e.g., CILT, FIATA, CISCM, APICS/ASCM, NIM, or equivalent).
	Demonstrable training in Customs procedures, Form M, PAAR, SON, NAFDAC, or National Single Window (NSW) operations is desirable.
	Membership of a relevant professional body is an added advantage.


Experience:


	Minimum of 5 years' experience in freight forwarding, customs clearing, shipping documentation, import operations, or supply chain management.
	At least 3 years' experience handling regulatory approvals involving NAFDAC, SON, NAQS, NESREA, and the Nigeria Customs Service.
	Proven experience processing Form M, PAAR, SONCAP, Product Certificates (PC), NAFDAC permits and Full Releases, and National Single Window (NSW) transactions.
	Demonstrated experience coordinating multiple import shipments from origin to final delivery.
	Experience liaising with government regulatory agencies, shipping lines, terminals, freight forwarders, and transport providers.
	Strong understanding of Nigerian import regulations, customs procedures, tariff classification (HS Codes), and international shipping documentation.
	Experience using Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Office Suite for operational reporting and data analysis.


Knowledge:


	Nigerian Customs import and export procedures.
	Form M and PAAR processing.
	National Single Window (NSW) platform.
	NAFDAC, SON, SONCAP, NESREA, and NAQS regulatory requirements.
	Shipping documentation, including Bills of Lading, Commercial Invoices, Packing Lists, Certificates of Origin, and Delivery Orders.
	Incoterms and international trade practices.
	Supply chain planning and logistics operations.
	Storage, demurrage, and port operations.
title: Senior Supply Chain Specialist at Fembol Group
